name: cat
about: The chunky ARMLESS PS1 mascot cat (player + every sewer NPC). ~1.07 m to the ear tips, faces -Z. Group names = the node names CatLook paints (fur: Body LegL LegR Head EarL EarR Tail; markings: Belly Muzzle; eyes: EyeL EyeR; nose: Nose). Each group's origin is its hinge: legs swing from the hip, the tail sways from its root. The texture is grey/cream on purpose: the game multiplies it by the chosen colours. Made by tools/make_creature_specs.py.

paint.note: 64x64 cat texture. GREY/CREAM ON PURPOSE: the game multiplies it by the chosen FUR / MARKINGS / EYES / NOSE colour, so only the shading shows. Layout: fur_stripes [0, 0, 32, 16], forehead [32, 0, 48, 16], fur [48, 0, 64, 16], inner_ear [0, 16, 16, 32], markings [16, 16, 32, 32], whiskers [32, 16, 48, 32], eye [48, 16, 64, 32], eye_rim [0, 32, 16, 48], nose [16, 32, 32, 48], paw [32, 32, 48, 48], tail [48, 32, 64, 48]
